D: A young man finds out the men in his family can travel back in time and uses it to find love and make the most of life.
P: Serve the main when Tim and Mary meet at the dinner in the dark.
S: the family's tea on the beach in Cornwall
Egg and cress sandwiches cut into fingers, the kind packed for a windy afternoon on a Cornish beach.
Little beef and vegetable pasties with flaky pastry, the classic Cornish snack. Mix 300g beef mince with finely diced potato, swede and onion.
M: Tim and Mary meeting at the pitch-black restaurant
Slow-cooked lamb shanks with mash, the kind of dish you could eat with your eyes shut.
W: Tim and Mary's wedding in the rain
Meringue, strawberries and cream crushed together, an easy English dessert for a soggy wedding day.
K: Tim's dad and their ping pong games
Proper English breakfast tea with milk. Brew 4 tea bags in a warmed pot of boiling water for 4 minutes.

s.note: the family's tea on the beach in Cornwall
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise and salt. Spread on 8 slices of buttered bread, add cress and cut into fingers.
Mix 300g beef mince with finely diced potato, swede and onion. Spoon onto rounds cut from 3 sheets shortcrust pastry, fold and crimp. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

m.note: Tim and Mary meeting at the pitch-black restaurant
m.how: Brown 4 lamb shanks, add a chopped onion, 2 carrots, 400g diced tomatoes and 500ml stock and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve on mash made from 800g potatoes.

w.note: Tim and Mary's wedding in the rain
w.how: Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks. Crush 8 meringue nests and fold through with 500g sliced strawberries. Spoon into glasses just before serving. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Tim's dad and their ping pong games
d.how: Brew 4 tea bags in a warmed pot of boiling water for 4 minutes. Pour into mugs with a splash of milk and sugar to taste.
